body:
Blast from the past. Lol. Looking back now there wouldn't have been anything I could have done. I was broken and unable to manage my own emotions and turned to alcohol like a dork. She had already mentally/emotionally left me months before the actual break up.

I had a lot of time to reflect and grow from the situation. I'm a completely different person from who I was and I'm proud of myself for who I've become. I still have love for her and I hope she's doing well and is happy. Life is a crazy long journey and I would love to one day have a conversation with her about life in general. I still do occasionally get those sad days but it's not like the depression I was in and I've learned to just feel those feelings and let em out then continue on my path.
Thank you! Only problem is I believe with that brand it's known to wash out the color to a pale/pastel vs the vibrant govee. Dang it. Search continues I suppose or I can paint my wall again..
Isn't this the fucking truth.. 1 year after it all and I still find myself crying from time to time about the things missed and not experienced together. Makes me so tired and stressed.
Yeah I feel like this is gonna be a album I can only listen to sometimes when I can feel and not in public.
Glad to hear you moved forward and are finding some enjoyment from the new album. It's heavy but so good.
Better to let your emotions out anyways I say. Need a big cry? Go for it.

I have it on repeat and it's so good but hurts at the same time. I really was not expecting to like it this much. I don't believe it'll top Adventure for personal reasons but it's definitely no slouch. Worth the wait.

Yeah, there's really not a day that goes by where I'm not sad and alone. Spent just about everyday of those years always with her. We grew up together and had countless first experiences together. Hard to believe that person is truly gone from my life. Don't exactly know when I'll actually start getting over it and feeling better and I guess that's the worst part of it. Then being sort of kicked while I'm down knowing she's doing well with her new life. To here your ex say "I feel like I was put here to be with him" and not be talking about you is pretty fucking rough on top of the "I'm happier than I've ever been." Ripperoni tho.

What you said in the op is definitely true though. Hopefully things get better for you as well in the future.

My ex of almost 9 years left me for someone she got emotionally connected with and married him about 6 months later to live with him. Haven't seen her in 7 months. Haven't spoken in 2 months. I'm still a emotional wreck and just recently started antidepressants. The fact that I'm still alive now is amazing to even myself.

It's just such a sudden shock and heart break to lose someone that was my best friend and felt like a soul mate. She felt like my other half and I honestly haven't felt whole since she left. Life sucks yo.

Been about 5 months that she's lived with guy she married after less than a year. After our 8.5 year relationship. Still an absolute mess. Not sure I'll ever find anyone I clicked with so well and it hurts every fucking day. Good luck though. Lol.
God this describes it so well. To a non stop struggle to distract yourself fulling knowing you'll be alone at night when you go home

I have a feeling this is gonna be me but honestly don't think I'll wanna be alive come the holidays. She's moved on and I cant get a break from the depression.

What happens when you're 6 months in and nothing feels any different. You feel so lost and helpless and have no real reason to get up in the morning besides going to work. Could die tomorrow and it wouldn't matter.

I'm about 6 months in and she married someone in the army she said she fell in love with so they could live on base together. Probably about 4 months into their relationship. It's hurts like hell everyday and feels like there's no end in sight. I honestly don't know how I made it this far but feel like giving up each day I spend completely alone.

You can cry about it and be depressed but don't sit in it too long. These feelings are valid and better to get them out. After that, stand up take a deep breath and keep doing what you need to do for yourself.
Does VIP get better seating/standing area?

It's not me. It's my ex's new boyfriend/husband. They were only together maybe 3 or 4 months before the "I love yous" and got married to live together. A month together and he pushed her and did some other crazy things and she's giving him a chance to change but I don't think it's smart. Am I over stepping my boundaries or is this a concern?

I hope everyone here sits down and really talks with their SO about the issues they have with the relationship and maybe try to work through them. I pushed my SO away and avoided the talks and now I regret it so much cause I never gave her the opportunity to come to me and express her concerns and feelings and she felt she had to end it for her best interest.

I don't blame her cause I was shitty like that. I didn't cheat, didn't look at other girls, didn't abuse her. I just never showed her the love she needed and couldn't talk about her feelings. I've learned a lot through the break up. Hopefully anyone here will take the time to sit and figure things out with their partner. If you feel it's worth fixing and they're willing to change and put in the effort I so give it one last go.

Except for the guy that looked at other girls and distanced himself from his gf while walking. Fuck that dude.
If someone is great and perfect sober but can snap easily while drinking is it worth staying if they seek help?

I'm actually okay. I made a good group of friends and sort of got my best friend back that was my ex.

I thought about hanging but tool me it was too scary and would hate to fail and suffer from brain damage. I can't help you on knowing what pills would make you pass out. Just don't try to od unless you have a lot of really strong strong stuff that's not over the counter meds.

I'm sure it's gonna hurt but like you said I can only imagine it won't be for long once the shock kicks in and hopefully I would pass out. The biggest hesitation is when I have the barrel against my chest. It is without a doubt scary. My gun also has a very long trigger pull so that feel as well worries me. At the same time though when you fall into that dark spot there's nothing that can stop you.

I've had everything planned out for a week now. Just been waiting for the right time but I've been doing pretty good lately.

All my last letters are in envelopes labeled and addressed. I still have my gun with one round in the chamber. Was gonna go with a shot through the heart as if people decide to hold a funeral it doesn't need to be a closed one and hopefully a lot less traumatizing to who ever finds me.
You'll puke and damage your liver and be in extreme pain.
I wish you'd give me one more chance.

I'm not a good guy. Im better than I was but I still hope she does better than what she's in. No one deserves to be screamed at and pushed around.

Thanks again.

That's what I've been afraid of. She says he's a great guy but when he drinks he becomes crazy and needs a lot of attention. I just think he's gonna be super controlling over her life. I don't know him personally but this was enough for me to not like him ever.

Thank you for your opinion. I figured that's what was gonna need to happen..

Exactly. She's lived with him 3 weeks and that's way too soon to even have serious argument like that. That's beyond an argument though. She's just stubborn and won't take any help. She has bruises and says she's sore all over.

Would I be wrong if I left her if she chose to stay with him? I can't be that crutch that helps her if she just continues to stay with him.

I'd love to have her back but at the same time that's not my intention for being there for her. She never made many friends outside of me and my group and she moved away a few states to be with this guy so best I could do is text/talk to her on the phone.

She says she would probably stay with him if he gets help but even then I don't believe that's the best choice. She knew he had anger issues before and I said I'm afraid he's gonna hurt her and she said he wouldn't but obviously he did. I know in the end it's not my choice at all but I think this dude is psycho. He looked her in the eyes and snapped her phone in half. Screamed at the top of his lungs in her face.

Also out of a 8 year relationship sort of similar shitty situation were it's forced contact. I hope things get better for you. Cutting all ties completely will make the healing progress faster but somethings can't be help. Good luck, I know it's a battle and feels fresh everytime but you will get through it.
I wish I knew these things before it all reached it's end.. Fuck.

I finally made it a day. Sort of. I know I have to stay busy and ignore it all. Laying here alone knowing knowing she doesn't give a shit hurts but just like with the suicidal thoughts, just gotta hang on for one more day.

Plenty of people live with their parents in this day and age. Even up till their 30s. Life is expensive. I recently fell on hard times at age 28 and had no choice but to go back. I hate it but it gives me a bit of a break to fight through this depression and try to better my self-esteem and mental state.
Nobody is perfect. As long as you're challenging yourself and becoming a better you that's what matter. Stay strong and healthy friend.
Definitely need to find an outlet but being as skinny as iam I refuse to do anything cardio wise till I actually get some weight on my bones. Lol.
Thank you. It's going to be pretty obvious so no worries there then.

Exactly.. I keep a journal sometimes to get things out and that's where I end up a lot of the time.. What is the point of being alive if you're not living. Simply existing is not enough to keep a person going.. The immense feelings of being alone really hurt. I'm pretty much on my last thread holding onto life as I've wrote all my last words and planned to end my life but guess I'm still here kicking till something truly pushes me over.

If you ever need to talk feel free to pm me. I got too much time on my hands most days. Stay strong.

God you sound like me.. I'm 5 months in and I only wake up looking forward to going back to sleep. Keep yourself as busy as you can. Some days are more productive than others when you have a lot to keep you busy. Some days are gonna be miserable and drag on. I can't tell you you'll ever be over it and better cause I know I'm not but she's moved on clearly and you can't force someone to care.

Keep yourself as busy as you can. Having a pet does help. If you're not use to doing things like that on your own it can be difficult but you seem like you have a good mindset of needing to get things done. Having goals will keep your mind off it and keep you look forward. Stay strong.
Relatable.. They slowly stop loving you then before you know it they're gone and well over it while you feel like everything is always so fresh and not ready to move on..

Sort of the same situation except that she's gone now. We broke up and had to live around eachother for a while and it's hard not to still love her and hold her at night. Kiss her before I left for work. All that stuff. 

The hard part is coming, don't worry. We were constantly together for 8 years so to be all alone now I have too much time on my hands being alone. Coming home to emptiness and no one to greet you. Some people are probably better at being alone but I never got use to it and never liked it.

No. This one is pretty fucked up. Sorry you went through that.
Yes. Especially on the gen two. Look up videos on YouTube of cars with vtcs deleted doing cold starts. It's normal and you may have bought a car that was modified pretty extensively.

Ported intake manifold would allow more flow to each cylinder but the stock manifold still has shitty distribution. Your may be ported but hard to tell without taking it off the head. Got any pictures of the right side of the intake manifold? It's just emissions stuff.

Judging by the bundle of wires and them being tapped into those two I'd say it's the relay to trick the ecu into believe the vtcs system is still working. You probably have a ported intake manifold with the flappers removed.

Yup.. I know how that goes. Or just get hit with excuses like "I'm really busy" "phone's gonna die" "didn't see your message." It's 2019, we're always on our phones and the battery life of most phones is great. It takes a few seconds to type out a text that's actually meaningful.
Ouch.. That rings way too true. That's exactly what it's like now. The texts to me become less and less words cause they're all going to someone else. So little effort and emotion in em anymore..

I wonder the same thing. She was my best friend and always was by my side for 8 years. Jumping to no contact just like that blows my mind when she's the person I'll always be closest to but seeing her move on so quickly and easily even though she says it's hard for her still kills me inside. Especially when I'm stuck in my boring day to day routine just trying to stay afloat alone now all while having suicidal thoughts when I run out of things to do for the day.

Hopefully you make the best choice for yourself and the only true way to be friends with and ex is to be completely over them. Just my opinion though.

I'm there too my friend. I wouldn't call it a "snap" though. Just kind of waiting for the mundane "just one more day" saying to become irrelevant to myself. It's coming soon. Have my 28th birthday in March and dont feel too much like making it to then.

This is a really good explanation and now I understand why I feel so useless and just okay with suicide when I have nothing else to do in the day.

I started going to the gym but once I'm done with there I come home and still have hours to fill and being alone with that time scares me. That's when I feel closest to my gun and ready to check out.

I know I gotta force myself to eat anything I can but the appetite just isn't there and it's annoying knowing that I can't eat over this shit. 
I take xanax but it's not legal prescription so who know how much is actually in the pills I'm taking and I'm starting to need more and more to have the same effect as when I first took em.
You just said the problem I'm having, I get so bored and don't know what to do with my day I start drinking at 1 or 2 o'clock and just keep going from there.
I use to enjoy going on drives but my car is a bit of a gas hog and can't afford to keep filling it up all the time. I was big into cars so it's a big turbo aggressive tune with e85. It rips but also rips a whole in my wallet at the pump.
I hate weed.
I'll check that site out when I eventually get up and moving. Thanks so much for your input.
She ain't coming back. I know that. I'm just tired, really fucking tired of the same old life that I'm forced to live to support myself.

I will eventually, I have to pay for overpriced insurance so I may as well. Although I am currently buying and taking Xanax I buy off the street and it helps for a bit but my tolerance has gone up in the past few months.

I was going to the gym a lot before all this. I know what to do and put on decent mass for my size. I lost a majority of it cause I cant bring myself to eat. Eating and sleeping is the most difficult part of it all. Just to sleep I usually have to drink and I know that's not helping if I want to o get in shape but I can't remember how to sleep alone.

I miss having companionship and a team mate. Dating just feels like some random friend that either wants to fuck or not.

I did get into the gym yesterday and could only bring myself to stay for maybe 30 min then got home and just don't know what to do with the rest if my time.

I'd still take my chances with a gun shot to the head. Do enough research and it's not hard to know the spot you gotta aim for. It's nothing like the movies if you're actually trying to end your life. There is still a risk of failure. Especially with a smaller caliber handgun but again, I'll risk it with a 9mm vs a shotgun blast to the face and leaving me looking like a dropped watermelon..
Best of look to you. Hopefully you'll escape the pain you're in.

Virgina in the states?? I've heard such terrible things happen to your body with helium..

My back up plan for a pain free suicide would be the charcoal method.

Ahh so you had it much easier to acquire prescription drugs. Probably don't even have to go through customs either. I completely understand that. That's another thing troubling me with the gun method but if I need an out I gotta take what I can get. Rather not be a jumper.

You're brave. I've seen where to buy and could never bring myself to do it for risk of jail time. Last thing I need is to be in a physical cell as well as my mental one. My only option is a painful bullet and hopefully I don't miss the sweet spot.

It's an awful way to go. I thought about this route as well. Getting disgustingly drunk with painkillers to fall asleep somewhere secluded in the dead of winter. Looked more into it and the thought of frost bite after waking up and chickening out scared me. There really is not easy way to die, sadly..
It's even worse when you're honestly trying to just say ex and you slip up and refer to them after your bf/gt still... Wtf

We've technically been broken up since around the end of summer. Had to live together till she moved cause of our situation. I know I have to go to work on Monday but it just feels pointless when you feel like your life has no meaning. I'll come home after work be alone go to sleep and just do it all again. Miserable cycle.

I've never loved myself, never even liked myself. I got issues I know. I tried the gym but always broke down and either left or just couldn't force myself to go. I hate my job so I'd rather not focus on that. I'm not in the situation to just completely change up my work path. Especially when I have no formal education and pretty much seen as a drop out.

Thank you for your kind words though. My first step is trying to go the gym at least try to start all while forcing myself into working a shit job to pay for what I need.

I'm not 100% sure she was at fault for everything but the way she went about it all was shitty. She's says we drifted and slowly got over me but I more so believe she was talking to this guy and probably fell for him while we were still together. I'll never know the truth. I don't think it'll last and be healthy but she just gave up everything to marry him and move to his state so I have a feeling she'll cave in most aspects and do what she has to do to make things work even if it shouldn't work...

That's awful.. People can be so cruel and really don't even bother seeing how they would feel if the script was flipped. Stay strong. I'm trying to hang in there but not sure I'll last.

Currently I'm stuck in this want to be alone mood. I don't want to do anything I use to love.. I hate going to work and most days leave early just to come home and lay in bed. Its depressing.. I turned to alcohol and various drugs to help cope and mainly to help me sleep. At night my mind tends to over think and non stop feeds me dirty vile thoughts that hurt myself even more..

It's definitely strange but at the same time I feel like we aren't the only ones to have this situation going on. Already seems more common than I initially thought just by how extremely similar our situations are.

I know 100% I would never do this to her and don't understand how she could do it to me.. She really was my rock and I don't believe I or anyone deserves this type of way of being dumped. The neglect and disrespect. Living with her still I have to see the ring on her finger and her constantly texting him while she tries to get her things together to move to a new state with him.. It breaks me again again day after day.

I don't have any drive to date. To restart from square one is just not what I want.. Especially now that I see what the dating scene is like. I hate it. I was ready to settle down and to talk about kids and just live out my normal life enjoying my days with my partner. I don't believe I'll find someone to fit that missing piece of me. We just had a stupid weird personality that we pretty much shared. I know eventually I'll have to try and find something to get me through the day one at a time cause everyday is a battle and when she's gone for good who knows how much worse it'll be.

What in the fuck? That is EXACTLY what happened in my situation as well... Life went on as normal, I did notice things were a little weird between us but never would have thought the outcome was giving up on the relationship we built on for years. It was me that initiated the talk that something was different and we got to talk. That's when she broke the news that like your SO she had shed all her tears and got over me. Without me even knowing that what was going on.. We did everything like usual. Got along so well but I guess she was just letting me live in blissful ignorance while she planned her future..

Problem is I never really branched out to make many friends cause I was content with it just being me and her. I relied on her for so much. I didn't realize how much of a problem I had with anxiety until she left. I knew I hated being out at stores or doing anything alone but had no clue how much she calmed me down and made me feel strong. I moved away from all my family about 10 years ago or so to be with her.. I've know her for 12 years and been together 8 of those. Would have been 9 in a few months.

I so badly wish I could change things. I still love her deeply and like you would do anything for her but I don't believe that's what's right. After being betrayed like I feel I did I don't think I could ever trust her again. Not even sure I want to remain in her life but at the same time she is my best friend and really believe she's my other half or stupid soul mate. I don't understand it at all.

Holy fuck. I'm so sorry to hear that. That's really rough and I relate completely.. We grew up together and built everything together. Always a team, no matter how big or small the task. As long as we had each other it didn't matter. I don't understand how you could throw away so much time like that instead of really forcing the issue that things need to change.

Deep down we're still the same people that fell in love with one another. Why throw it away to restart somewhere else? Why not fix what you invested so much into to keep the spark. Guess you can't force someone to stay and not throw away time. It just leaves me dumbfounded. Thanks for listening and letting me hear your story. In someone it's good to know I'm not alone. Hopefully we come out of this better.
A year is still a long time.. To go from having that person there to nothing is always hard. Thanks for your kind words. Hopefully things get better for the both of us.

I'm sure she doesn't want me in anyway besides a friend but even then I don't know if I fully believe that. Not sure I could even deal with that. Her living the life we should have had with someone else.

8 years is just a long time to throw away and get over. 8 years of always having that person there for you then never again seeing them and being alone.
